24.description: Saskatoon's University Heights 3 Neighbourhood will be named Sunrise, following targeted engagement with Indigenous communities. The name Hawthorn was also added to the city's master list.

chips.text: Approved
5 for, 0 against
Councillor Timon raised concerns about future policy budget and staff time.
Expedited community engagement was an exception to existing policy, setting a precedent.
Elders and young people advocated for the name Sunrise due to its traditional significance.
Name selection involved ceremonial practices and Indigenous community engagement.
Sunrise name connects to Indigenous teachings about the sun greeting the land.
Neighborhood entrance signs could include Indigenous references and other languages.
